surface_value: The Respondent has infringed the Applicant's copyright subsisting in certain drawings by making a two-dimensional and three-dimensional reproduction of the Work from December 2003 to commencement of the trial in this proceedings (19 June 2006). The Court ordered various restraining orders, financial compensations, and reserved costs and interest payments.
